Give the floor soft lower-contrast texture, walkways read clearly and silhouettes of permanent obstacles read distinctly. Geometry at a glance: the upper 28% contains most of the buildings and tall decor, central and lower playable ground extends across the frame. Some atmospheric scenery can go along the left, right and bottom edges, but keep the playable ground clear. Layout is very open and lateral, with clear negative space for the heroes at left, enemies at center and right. Look-down three-quarter camera, roofs occupy top 25-37%.
